parsed.summary: The proposed patch optimizes URLResolver construction by ensuring consistent use of settings.ROOT_URLCONF, which should reduce unnecessary calls to _populate. The changes are minimal and well-structured.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new function _get_resolver, which is not immediately clear from the function name alone. It could benefit from a more descriptive name or a comment explaining its purpose.
